description: Get metadata and access links for a captured investor-event slide deck by event id. Returns the same deck metadata as REST: event and ticker, call date, deck title and source, PDF versus image-slideshow kind, page count, capture time, MIME type, and either the deck's public PDF URL or its ordered public slide-image URLs, which open in a browser without an API key. The binary PDF/image contents are not embedded in the response. Get the event id from ListInvestorEvents or GetEarningsCallEvent.

eventId.description: The investor event id (from ListInvestorEvents or GetEarningsCallEvent)

name: GetInvestorEventSlideMetadata
title: Investor Event Slide Metadata
